articles.title: Finally! The World's Fairest Dice — and It Took 15 Years!
articles.summary: Mathematicians invented five 60-sided dice that are perfectly fair for any number of players. It took 15 years to design them!

articles.title: Alcaraz Is Back and Better Than Ever at the US Open!
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz won his third match at the US Open after a wrist injury. He says he's getting better every game!

articles.title: Jay-Z's London Show Has Fireworks, Fugees, and a Birthday Surprise!
articles.summary: Jay-Z played his first London concert in 13 years, singing Happy Birthday to Beyoncé and bringing out the Fugees!
